articleMobileDpr2.deployedObserver: Present with rootMargin 600px; callback sets loading=eager and assigns img.src to itself. It did not fire in the observed production run: loading stayed lazy while all four cards were inside the viewport.
articleMobileDpr2.screenshotAttempt: Timed out after 20 seconds; no screenshot artifact was claimed. DOM/resource evidence remained readable before the attempt.

homepageMobileDpr3.note: Contradicts Batch 40 claim that mobile DPR1/2/3 all select 300x300. DPR3 correctly selects 600w candidates for sharpness. The rendered box is not 1:1.

claimContradictions: Reported boxes 164.5x183, 349.4x228, and 379.3x288 are not square, so the statement that all configurations preserve a 1:1 rendered ratio is false.

conclusion: The scroll timeout is fixed, but acceptance criterion 1 still fails because in-viewport article images remain blank and unrequested. Criterion 3 remains unsupported by an auditable matrix and contains false source/ratio claims.
